jobs.occupation: Weekend Production Operator – Flexible Schedule, Attractive Pay, and Career Growth
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a rewarding and well-paid temporary opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a modern production environment? As a Weekend Production Operator, you will play a key role in ensuring smooth and efficient operations for a well-respected company in Kaulille. This temporary role runs from July through September and is ideal for individuals who are available and motivated to work long weekend shifts.

Your typical day involves operating and monitoring state-of-the-art machines, conducting quality checks, and maintaining strict hygiene and safety standards. You'll rotate between day and night shifts: one week you'll work from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM, and the following week from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. You will also be responsible for cleaning equipment, applying HACCP procedures, and stepping in wherever needed on the production floor to support your team.

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and you're looking to boost your income over the summer, this is the role for you. Apply now to join a team where your reliability and technical insight are valued, and where there’s potential for a long-term position based on your performance!

• Commitment to work weekends for the full 3-month period (July–September)
• Availability for both day (6:00 AM–6:00 PM) and night (6:00 PM–6:00 AM) shifts on a rotating basis
• Good command of English or Dutch
• Technical insight or an affinity for technical work
• Ability to work accurately, hygienically, and safely
• Suitable for candidates not in full-time weekday employment

Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 3-5 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Are you ready to start your career as a Maintenance Technician in a dynamic and technology-driven environment? As a Maintenance Technician, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring the optimal performance of our client's advanced machinery.

On an average day, you'll troubleshoot machine malfunctions, perform preventive maintenance, and collaborate with machine setters and operators to enhance production processes. Your proactive efforts will contribute to improvements in quality, output, and safety.

If you're eager to embark on a fulfilling career, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable part of our team dedicated to innovation and excellence.

• Technical school degree

• Good level of English

• Flexibility, motivation, and a strong sense of responsibility

• Experience in pneumatics and hydraulics is a plus

• Problem-solving mindset

• Willingness to work shifts

As a future butcher / deboner of pork meat, you will work on different lines with tasks such as cutting shoulders, bellies, and ribs. 

Experience is an asset, but motivated newcomers are welcome. 

Thanks to the Butchers Academy, you will receive comprehensive training, followed by a permanent contract and annual evaluations offering opportunities for advancement.

We are looking for ambitious and eager-to-learn individuals who can start early (start at 4.55 AM) and are flexible in their schedules depending on the season. 

You should be comfortable working in a cold environment and have an affinity for the food industry (pork meat), along with the associated quality and hygiene standards. 

You must be physically capable of standing and working all day and place importance on workplace safety. 

Language is not a barrier; everyone has equal opportunities, whether you speak English, French, or Dutch.

You work on a production line in the cold, warm or expedition department. You fill, garnish or label products and ensure everything runs smoothly with your colleagues. You follow strict hygiene and quality rules. You contribute to a safe and organized workplace.

• Good Dutch or fluent English

• Fast and accurate working style (line work)

• Strong focus on quality and hygiene

• Neat appearance (no gel nails, visible piercings, etc.)

• Comfortable working in cold (0–4°C)

• Team player

• Experience in production is a plus

jobs.occupation: English-speaking CE truck driver - frozen food transport
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced CE Driver who's living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home most evenings?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Inside Sales Representative (English + East EU language)
jobs.description:
As an Inside Sales Representative, you are responsible for providing excellent service and commercial support to customers in a specific region: Middle East, Africa and Eastern Europe. You work hand in hand with the External Sales Representative and help strengthen customer relationships, drive sales growth, and promote the use of our digital tools. 

Key responsibilities:
 
 

• Open new customer accounts (approx. 30%) and grow business with existing customers (approx. 70%) 

• Prepare accurate offers and price calculations 

• Enter and follow up on orders 

• Actively manage your accounts via phone and email, with a focus on cross-selling and digital migration 

• Maintain and update customer data in the internal system 

• Understand customer needs, market context, product applications, and competitors 

• Be the main point of contact for customer inquiries, complaints, and support 

• Identify and close commercial opportunities 

• Report on sales projects and progress in close collaboration with External Sales 

• Contribute to the team with flexibility and a hands-on attitude 
 

• You have a technical and/or commercial background 

• You have at least 4 years of B2B sales experience, preferably with technical products 

• You are fluent in English (spoken and written) – mandatory 

• Polish, Czech or another Eastern European language is a strong asset 

• French and/or Arabic is an asset 

• Strong skills in Excel and general IT tools 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• You are proactive, persuasive, structured, and a true team player 

• Able to multitask and work under pressure in a small but ambitious team
